00.name: Narrator
00.text: As you continue to walk you see lord Pasta's mountain castle come into view.

02.name: Sweat
02.text: Not quite. Lord Pasta has asked us to use a secret side door. So secret not even me or Sour know about it.

03.name: Narrator
03.text: The group walks up to the castle then walks around the side of it until you spot the secret side door and a lump of scattered stone lying in sront of the door.

04.name: Narrator
04.text: As the group walks closer towards the door the scattered stones start to shake and mold together forming a humanoid shape.

09.name: Stone Golem
09.text: WELCOME. HOME. SWEAT. SOUR. THIRD. LIFEFORM. UNKOWN. TO. GOLEM

12.name: Lumberjack
12.text: Password. I don't have a password.

13.name: Sour
13.text: No need to panic lumberer, me and Sweaty each halve half of the password. My half is 'Rigat0ni2005'.

fight_sweat_3.name: Sweat
fight_sweat_3.text: Bacause this whole adventure you've always sided with Sour and never me, even after all those times Sour got us lost and made you fight guardians and lords. I've had enough. Let's see how much fun you'll have fighting a stone golem and one of lord Pasta's greatest advisors.

fight_sweat_5.name: Sweat
fight_sweat_5.text: If anything the mortal has driven me crazy.

fight_sweat_6.name: Stone Golem
fight_sweat_6.text: NO. PASSWORD. GIVEN. ATTACK. SEQUENCE. INITIALISED.

fight_sour_0.name: Sweat
fight_sour_0.text: Worry not mortal, Sour and me each halve half of the password. My half is 'Lingu1ne1!'.

fight_sour_2.name: Sour
fight_sour_2.text: Hmph. Like I'm going to tell you.

fight_sour_4.name: Sour
fight_sour_4.text: What. You think you can just side with Sweaty all the time and think I'll just help you at the end when you finally need me. You think I'm just some smuck who's only job is to tag along and watch Sweaty work you to the bone and then endanger your life. And after all that you still keep choosing there way even though they made you drop your axe to avoid a fight. Well now you've got yourself a fight, how do you like the sound of fighting a stone golem and a lord's advisor.

fight_sour_5.name: Sweat
fight_sour_5.text: Sour stop this madness at once.

fight_sour_6.name: Sour
fight_sour_6.text: I'm not mad. You two are the ones that are mad.

fight_sour_7.name: Stone Golem
fight_sour_7.text: NO. PASSWORD. GIVEN. ATTACK. SEQUENCE. INITIALISED.

14.name: Sweat
14.text: Worry not mortal, Sour and me each halve half of the password. My half is 'Lingu1ne1!'.

16.name: Lumberjack
16.text: Great but what order do I say it in.

27.name: Stone Golem
27.text: WOULD. YOU. LIKE. TO. SETUP. TWO. STEP. AUTHENTICATION. FOR. A. FASTER. AND. SAFER. LOGIN. EXPERIENCE

28.name: Sweat
28.text: Maybe later. Now move your stone backside out the way.

29.name: Narrator
29.text: The golem moves out of your way and now no longer blocks the door.

bad_wrong_1.name: Sweat
bad_wrong_1.text: That wasn't even close to what we said.
